The embeddable_hosts setting was a free-text admin-entered host_list, and validation is absent at insert time here; a value containing a single quote or other SQL metacharacter would break or alter the migration. The mechanism is verifiable directly in the diff and is a genuine robustness/injection defect introduced by this change.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration reads the legacy site_settings value for 'embeddable_hosts', splits it into lines, and for each line executes raw interpolated SQL: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Because `h` comes directly from stored free-text settings, any single quote or SQL metacharacter in that value can break the migration or alter the SQL executed. This is a real, diff-verifiable correctness/security defect (non-parameterized SQL in a migration).
